name: Quorum before final
description: A council decision on any proposal may not be marked FINAL until at least three distinct vote_cast events for that proposal appear in the log.

name: One vote per member
description: For any given proposal, each council_member may cast at most one vote_cast event in the log.

name: Appeals follow decisions
description: An appeal_filed event for a proposal must occur strictly after that proposal's decision has been marked FINAL in the log.

name: Redaction requires request
description: Every redaction_applied event must be preceded in the log by a redaction_requested event for the same document_id and field.

name: No unlogged overrides
description: Every override_decision event must be followed by an override_logged event before any new enforcement_started event for that proposal.

name: Enforcement after finalization
description: Every enforcement_started event for a proposal must occur after that proposal's decision has been marked FINAL or has been overridden in the log.
